{{Top|leg}}
The '''mapping skiff''' was a small, intra-system craft developed by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] as a means of completing preliminary mapping of the terrain and environment of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was usually deployed from a mother ship into a planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
